rows.definition: The agent harness's mapping from a reasoning effort profile (low/med/high/ultra) and the current turn assessment to a recurrent loop count for a looped model, clamped to [1, maxLoops]; an error turn raises depth one step and a non-looped model always gets 1.
rows.distinction: Harness-side choice of recurrent depth for the next request, not the gateway's per-request receipt of the depth actually selected (LoopDepthReceipt) and not an agent turn loop or retry loop.
